To: timeline:rosario.bautista
Replying to: none
Cc: none
Subject: none

HAPPY HAPPY NEWS!!! 🎉🎉🎉 Lorna Villaruz’s NMC PIN came through today, and she is officially a registered nurse in the UK!!! 🙏❤️

Lorna, my best friend, my sister from another mother, my forever partner in crime — I am so proud of you! From our nursing school days in Iloilo, and that capping ceremony in 1996, to all the years since, you have always been one of the best nurses I know. Calm, kind, and loved by your patients. Ward 7 at Mersey Bank Hospital is so lucky to have you!

We’ve been friends since we were polishing our white shoes in the dorm every night. And by “we,” I mean I polished mine and you borrowed my shoe polish again because you never bought your own 😂 Some things never change!

When I left for the UK in 2004, you cried at the airport and said, “Susunod ako — I will follow you.” Well, it only took 22 years, haha! You’ve worked so hard through all those papers and exams, and now the next stop really is Liverpool. I’ll never forget sending you that photo of the rain when you were in Nottingham for your OSCE. Just a little preview of what you’re in for 🌧️😂

We’re counting down now: Lorna lands in Manchester on 14 January, and starts on Ward 7 on 25 January! Bring the dried mangoes and pili for Tito Ben — he says you’re already welcome, and our spare room is ready for your first month with us. I’ve started making space, and I promise to show you the 14 bus into town. But please, please bring a proper coat. Liverpool wind is no joke! 🧥

Lorna, welcome to Liverpool and welcome to our Filipino family here. You have Christmas parties, pancit, lots of kabayan ready to help, and Simbang Gabi with us next year to look forward to. There’s a place for you at our table and in our family, always. ❤️

After 20 years of telling you to come, I can finally say: you’re coming!!! I can’t wait to have you here, make new memories, and hear your laugh in the house again. So proud, so happy, and so excited for you, my friend. Liverpool, please help me give Lorna the biggest welcome! 🎉❤️🎉

reasons: Omits Lorna's almost 18 years working in Riyadh and then Dubai, which the request required; everything else checks out.
